items.title: Receiver firmware V8: disconnection issue
items.summary: Firmware V8 causes frequent USB disconnects. Stay on V7; if you already updated, flash back to V7.
body: Symptom: the receiver disconnects during use and only recovers after unplugging and replugging the USB receiver.
Action: stay on V7. Receivers already on V8 should be flashed back to V7.
Next: V9 is being fixed and will be announced here when released.

items.title: Blender plugin Beta 11.20 paused
items.summary: Beta 11.20 has abnormal behaviour reports; its download is paused. Keep using Beta 11.16.
body: We received reports of abnormal behaviour in Beta 11.20, so its download has been taken down.
Keep using Beta 11.16 until a fixed build is released.
If you installed 11.20 from another source, uninstall it and go back to 11.16.

items.title: Rebocap for UE plugin V3 released
items.summary: V3 is live for UE 4.26 – 5.9. Note: the anim node no longer reconnects automatically.
body: Supported engines: UE 4.26 – 5.9, with per-version zips plus UE5 / UE4 source packages.
Behaviour change: since V3 the anim node does not reconnect automatically after Live Link disconnects; reconnect manually.
To upgrade: replace the plugin folder, restart the editor, and check that Plugins shows V3.

items.title: Android Preview 0.2 and Meta invite link
items.summary: Android Preview 0.2 is available; the Meta Horizon Store beta invite link has been updated.
body: Android Preview 0.2 supports tracker V16 / V17 and receiver V6 / V7 / V8.
The Meta Horizon Store beta invite link has been refreshed — use the new card on the download page.
Android and Meta now have separate tabs on the download page.

items.title: SDK v3 builds updated (Windows / Linux)
items.summary: New Python, C# and C++ builds; Linux packages are now listed separately.
body: Downloads are now split into Windows and Linux sections, so you cannot pick the wrong platform.
Python, C# and C++ builds have been refreshed; older builds stay in the collapsed history sections.
Every download shows its update date.

items.title: Rebocap V02 Beta02.2 (gray02-2) gray release
items.summary: A gray release for strong magnetic interference and the new UI modules. New users should stay on V01.
body: Supports tracker V16 and receiver V6 / V7 / V8.
Recommended for areas with heavy metal or trampolines, and for trying the new UI modules.
This is a gray release; if you are new to Rebocap, use the stable V01 first.
